caption: A unicycle wheel rolls over a small curb; the rider adjusts their position to keep upright.
positive_analysis:
The wheel contacting the curb edge rotates forward to climb over the raised stone.
The rider's leg drives the pedal so the wheel rolls up and over the curb.
As the wheel rises, the rider shifts their torso to keep the seat balanced.
The bracing foot lifts once the wheel clears the top of the curb.
